label: Folder sizes
description: Total size of a folder and its biggest entries.

params.name: top
params.description: How many of the biggest entries to list.

params.name: max_entries
params.description: Stop counting after this many files and folders.

label: Search in file
description: Find the lines in a text file that contain some text, with their line numbers.

params.name: case_sensitive
params.description: Match upper and lower case exactly.

params.name: before
params.description: Lines to show before each match.

params.name: after
params.description: Lines to show after each match.

params.name: max_matches
params.description: Stop listing after this many matches. The total is still counted.

label: Head file
description: Read the first lines of a text file of any size.

label: List directory
description: List the entries in a folder.

label: Read file
description: Read a file, up to 8 MiB, with its SHA-256. Give start_line or end_line to read lines from a text file of any size.

params.name: start_line
params.description: First line to read, counting from 1.

params.name: end_line
params.description: Last line to read. One reply holds up to 5000 lines.

label: Search files
description: Find files by name under a folder.

params.name: max_depth
params.description: How many folders deep to look.

label: Stat path
description: Size, times, attributes and link target for one path.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute path to a file or folder.

label: Tail file
description: Read the last lines of a text file of any size.

label: Directory tree
description: Walk a folder tree up to a depth and entry cap.
